$comment: Single source of truth for the text limits of everything the lab registers or publishes. 'max' is the ENFORCED limit (platform limit minus a safety margin); 'platformMax' is the limit of the platform itself. Every limit that caused a real failure is marked 'observed'. Read by scripts/Test-A365Names.ps1 (Lab Builder, Demo Builder). Change a limit ONLY with evidence, and record it in 'evidence'.

name.patternRule: starts with 'ext_', then letters and digits only: NO underscore, hyphen, space or accent after 'ext_' (Power Platform encodes '_' as '-5f' in connector ids: +2 characters each)
name.evidence: observed 2026-09: names above 20 are rejected by the registration

proxyConnectorId.templateRule: {rest} = the name after 'ext_', lowercased, every '_' encoded as '-5f'; the two hex blocks are 16 characters each in every tenant
proxyConnectorId.evidence: observed 2026-09: a 65-character proxy connector (name with an underscore after 'ext_') made the gateway expose a single 'Error' tool, left the connectionsMcp page blank and made the server undeletable; 62 characters work

description.evidence: observed 2026-09: a 93-character server description failed the registration and left orphan Entra apps plus a reserved connector display name

reservedNumbering.rule: servers that must be re-registered (demo resets) use ext_<Base><NN>, NN = 01..99, validated at the worst case NN = 99; a number is never reused, not even after a failed registration (a failed registration can reserve the display name forever)

name.patternRule: lowercase ASCII snake_case: letters, digits and '_' only, starting with a letter
name.unique: a tool name may be declared by ONE active server only (the gateway and the agents cannot disambiguate two servers exposing the same tool)

mcpTool.backendMatch: the backend must expose EXACTLY the declared tool names (checked with MCP tools/list before registering)

nameShort.evidence: observed 2026-09 and Lab Builder rule 1 (DW name.short)

descriptionShort.evidence: observed 2026-09: an AI-teammate manifest upload failed with a description.short above 80

displayName.evidence: instance creation form (admin center / Teams) accepts up to 32 characters

codeAgentName.patternRule: starts with a letter; letters, digits and single hyphens; no '--', no trailing hyphen
codeAgentName.evidence: Lab Builder naming rules 1b/2 (Azure Container Apps, DW name.short)

displayName.evidence: kept within the Teams/Microsoft 365 channel short name (30)

userAlias.patternRule: lowercase ASCII letters/digits separated by single '.', '_' or '-' (diacritics are removed first)

attributeName.note: cannot be deleted once created (only deactivated)

policyName.note: DLP, retention, Communication Compliance policies and eDiscovery cases

segment.rule: no leading/trailing space or dot; no forbidden characters

general.fictionalDomains: sample e-mail and web domains must be reserved example domains (example.com, example.org, example.net, *.example)
